title: Starter House with Farm and Kitchen
sourceTitle: Pokopia Pokemon 🌱 Starter House Build Guide with Farm and Kitchen!
creator: ゆりも / Yurimo
summary: A cozy early-game Pokopia starter base with a compact house, covered outdoor cooking area, fenced farm plots, storage, garden lighting, and vegetable baskets arranged around a warm wooden-and-vine exterior.
publicNotes:
## Build Notes

Yurimo's starter base packs the house, farm, and cooking area into one early-game footprint. The front uses a warm porch with vines, berry-style lights, wooden steps, and a compact roofline, while the side yard opens into a covered outdoor kitchen and fenced crop plots.

The video presents it as a first home for living with Pokemon, with farming and cooking close enough to feel practical rather than purely decorative.
